description: This file defines a terminal-based test reporter class for the Playwright testing framework, including output formatting, error handling, and summary generation.

classes.name: TerminalReporter
classes.description: A class implementing a terminal-based test reporter for Playwright, handling test output, summaries, and error formatting.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed failure report for a test, including attachments and error messages.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats a test error into a detailed message with stack trace and snippets.

methods.name: formatResultErrors
methods.description: Formats errors from a test result for display.

methods.name: markErrorsAsReported
methods.description: Marks errors in a test result as reported to avoid duplicate reporting.

methods.name: relativeFilePath
methods.description: Computes relative file path based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: relativeTestPath
methods.description: Gets relative path for a test file.

methods.name: stepSuffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix string for test steps.

methods.name: formatTestTitle
methods.description: Creates a formatted test title string.

methods.name: formatTestHeader
methods.description: Creates a formatted header for a test, including error steps if needed.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Creates a separator line for output formatting.

methods.name: prepareErrorStack
methods.description: Parses and prepares an error stack trace for display.

methods.name: characterWidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a character.

methods.name: stringWidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string.

methods.name: suffixOfWidth
methods.description: Returns a suffix of a string that fits within a specified width.

methods.name: resolveOutputFile
methods.description: Resolves output file path for a reporter based on environment variables and options.

methods.name: groupAttachments
methods.description: Groups test attachments by name pattern into expected, actual, diff, previous.
